description: Official Windows 11 ISOs the build accepts as its source. Download in a browser from https://www.microsoft.com/software-download/windows11 (Windows 11 multi-edition ISO for x64) into any profile's Downloads. Build-Iso.ps1 refuses a source ISO whose SHA-256 is neither listed here nor in config/source-iso.local.json. Don't edit this file to accept another ISO (a newer release, another language): the build's pre-flight prints that ISO's SHA-256 and the exact text to save as config/source-iso.local.json (same layout; git ignores it, and the ISO's build inputs carry it), once you have compared the SHA-256 with the one on Microsoft's download page ('Verify your download').
